post.summary: Create a website monitor; any check type can be turned on and set up here

ssl_extra_hostnames.description: SSL (a list, or one per line)

uptime_check_headers.description: Request headers, e.g. {"Accept": "text/html"}. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON.

uptime_check_json_assertions.description: JSON response assertions (dot paths), e.g. [{"path": "status", "expected": "ok"}]. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON.

uptime_check_header_patterns.description: Response headers that must match, a regex or substring, e.g. [{"header": "Content-Type", "pattern": "text/html"}]. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON.

dns_blocklist_interval_minutes.description: DNS blocklist: minutes between checks (360, 720 or 1440); null is 1440

dns_blocklist_lists.description: DNS blocklist: the lists to check; null is the default set

dns_blocklist_check_mail.description: DNS blocklist: also check the domain's own MX servers and SPF ip4:/ip6: addresses

dns_blocklist_extra_targets.description: DNS blocklist: extra domains or IP addresses to check (or one per line), up to 10

sitemap_urls.description: Sitemap: up to 10 sitemap URLs to check (or one per line); empty finds them from robots.txt and the usual locations

sitemap_max_urls.description: Sitemap: URLs checked per run (default 500); a longer sitemap is checked in turns

sitemap_alert_after_failures.description: Sitemap: failing runs in a row before alerting (default 2)

sitemap_alert_on_change.description: Sitemap: alert when listed URLs drop past sitemap_alert_drop_pct, the sitemap moves, or a sitemap file disappears

sitemap_alert_drop_pct.description: Sitemap: percent drop in listed URLs that counts as a change (default 20)

sitemap_check_indexability.description: Sitemap: load each page to flag noindex and canonical links that point elsewhere (default true)

sitemap_ignore_patterns.description: Sitemap: URL patterns to leave unchecked, e.g. ["/tag/*"] (or one per line), up to 100

crawl_time_limit_minutes.description: Crawl: stop after this many minutes

crawl_ignore_patterns.description: Crawl: URL patterns to skip, e.g. ["/admin/*"] (or one per line), up to 100

crawl_request_headers.description: Headers the crawler sends, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer …"}. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON.

robots_txt_watched_paths.description: Robots.txt (a list, or one per line)

lighthouse_thresholds.description: Lighthouse thresholds; keys you leave out keep their values

dns_record_ignore_patterns.description: DNS records (a list, or one per line)

dns_record_hosts.description: DNS records (a list, or one per line)

bearerAuth.description: Personal access token from Profile → API & data (monitors:read; monitors:write for any change, or only incidents:write / status-pages:write; optionally one organization, some monitors and an expiry), or an OAuth access token from an app you connected (limited to the organization you chose). 120 requests a minute per token; see the X-RateLimit-* headers

check_body.description: null unless you can edit the monitor with a read and write token

check_headers.description: null unless you can edit the monitor with a read and write token (it may hold credentials)

json_assertions.description: null unless you can edit the monitor with a read and write token (it may hold credentials)

header_patterns.description: null unless you can edit the monitor with a read and write token (it may hold credentials)

ping_url.description: GET or POST it from your job; append /starting or /failed

request_headers.description: null unless you can edit the monitor with a read and write token (it may hold credentials)

settings.description: Every check setting under its write field name, as createMonitor and updateMonitor take them; credentials are null unless you can edit the monitor with a read and write token

ssl_extra_hostnames.description: SSL (a list, or one per line)

uptime_check_headers.description: Request headers, e.g. {"Accept": "text/html"}. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON.

uptime_check_json_assertions.description: JSON response assertions (dot paths), e.g. [{"path": "status", "expected": "ok"}]. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON.

uptime_check_header_patterns.description: Response headers that must match, a regex or substring, e.g. [{"header": "Content-Type", "pattern": "text/html"}]. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON.

dns_blocklist_interval_minutes.description: DNS blocklist: minutes between checks (360, 720 or 1440); null is 1440

dns_blocklist_lists.description: DNS blocklist: the lists to check; null is the default set

dns_blocklist_check_mail.description: DNS blocklist: also check the domain's own MX servers and SPF ip4:/ip6: addresses

dns_blocklist_extra_targets.description: DNS blocklist: extra domains or IP addresses to check (or one per line), up to 10

sitemap_urls.description: Sitemap: up to 10 sitemap URLs to check (or one per line); empty finds them from robots.txt and the usual locations

sitemap_max_urls.description: Sitemap: URLs checked per run (default 500); a longer sitemap is checked in turns

sitemap_alert_after_failures.description: Sitemap: failing runs in a row before alerting (default 2)

sitemap_alert_on_change.description: Sitemap: alert when listed URLs drop past sitemap_alert_drop_pct, the sitemap moves, or a sitemap file disappears

sitemap_alert_drop_pct.description: Sitemap: percent drop in listed URLs that counts as a change (default 20)

sitemap_check_indexability.description: Sitemap: load each page to flag noindex and canonical links that point elsewhere (default true)

sitemap_ignore_patterns.description: Sitemap: URL patterns to leave unchecked, e.g. ["/tag/*"] (or one per line), up to 100

crawl_time_limit_minutes.description: Crawl: stop after this many minutes

crawl_ignore_patterns.description: Crawl: URL patterns to skip, e.g. ["/admin/*"] (or one per line), up to 100

crawl_request_headers.description: Headers the crawler sends, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer …"}. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON.

robots_txt_watched_paths.description: Robots.txt (a list, or one per line)

lighthouse_thresholds.description: Lighthouse thresholds; keys you leave out keep their values

dns_record_ignore_patterns.description: DNS records (a list, or one per line)

dns_record_hosts.description: DNS records (a list, or one per line)

lighthouse.description: Latest scores (0-100) per device the monitor audits, mobile and/or desktop; null when Lighthouse is off

scope_ids.description: Monitor, group or team IDs, or tags (wildcards allowed), for the scope

compare.description: Also compute the previous window of the same length; default true

filter_tags.description: Only monitors with one of these tags (wildcards allowed), whatever the breakdown

filter_team_ids.description: Only monitors in these teams, whatever the breakdown

p50_ms.description: Daily medians averaged, weighted by timed checks

p95_ms.description: Daily p95s averaged, weighted by timed checks

records.description: Record type => added and removed values

destination.description: The address, topic or host alerts go to; secrets are never returned

signing_secret.description: webhook: the key for Observe-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body)

rotation_hours.description: 24 daily, 168 weekly, 336 every two weeks, or any length

restriction_start.description: H:i: only on call from this time of day (with restriction_end; may wrap midnight)

user_ids.description: Members who are not viewers, in rotation order

id.description: A member (not a viewer), an on-call schedule or a notification channel
